people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Hadad
people.line: An Edomite prince who opposed Solomon.

translations.web: Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt, when Hadad was still a little child.
translations.bsb: But Hadad, still just a young boy, had fled to Egypt, along with some Edomites who were servants of his father.
translations.kjv: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father's servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.
